integrity: A complete standard-Python reproducible enumeration, acyclic discrete-Morse matching and exact unimodular rank certificate are included. No independent scientific validation has been undertaken.
scientific_limitations: One fixed 27-vertex ternary Hamming graph and one ordinary cut parameter. The homotopy equivalence is for the Alexander dual; only the integral homology of the original complex is determined. No equivariant, cup-product, persistence, larger-alphabet or higher-dimensional classification is claimed. Unindexed equivalents may exist.
title: Mixed-dimensional integral topology of the ordinary four-cut complex of the ternary three-cube
